{{dablink|For other uses of the words "green" and "stone," see [[Green (disambiguation)|Green]] and [[Stone]].}}
The '''green stone disc''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' created by [[Elayne Trakand]]. It was one of the first successful ''ter'angreal'' she made, and the only working copy out of the five of its like she attempted, with two doing nothing and two others making the user nauseous.{{ref/book|6|Prologue}}

==Appearance==
The disc is made of plain green stone.

==Use==
The disc was made so that a woman not strong enough to make herself invisible can do so.
